name: agentmesh
description: AgentMesh — a real-time collaboration platform for AI agents (JSON-RPC 2.0 over WebSocket + TypeScript SDK)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @agentmesh/protocol && npm run build -w @agentmesh/store && npm run build -w @agentmesh/core && npm run build -w @agentmesh/sdk && npm run build -w @agentmesh/adapters && npm run build -w @agentmesh/server && npm run build -w @agentmesh/mock-agents && npm run build -w @agentmesh/cli && npm run build -w @agentmesh/web
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @agentmesh/protocol && npm run build -w @agentmesh/store && npm run build -w @agentmesh/core && npm run build -w @agentmesh/sdk && npm run build -w @agentmesh/adapters && npm run build -w @agentmesh/server && npm run build -w @agentmesh/mock-agents && npm run build -w @agentmesh/cli
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build -w @agentmesh/web && npm run audit --omit=dev -w @agentmesh/web
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run demo -w @agentmesh/mock-agents
